central_claim: Patients with extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma are eligible for recruiting trials that a condition search on their own diagnosis will never return, because eligibility is written on the molecular/fusion class while the searched conditions field is written on histology, and a naive keyword fix cannot reliably tell a real admission from a false one, so it must be adjudicated trial-by-trial.

p1s.summary: §2's sentence ‘those three, and NCT06239272, the one record that lists the histology’ reads, in isolation, as a claim that NCT06239272 is the only one of the 23 clean-rerun records that lists EMC in its conditions. It is not: fet-fusion-trial-eligibility-2026-08-07.json flags emc_in_listed_conditions:true for two other trials — NCT03600649 (listed_conditions includes the exact string ‘Extraskeletal Myxoid Chondrosarcoma’) and NCT05836571 (‘Locally Advanced Extraskeletal Myxoid Chondrosarcoma’) — and both also appear in the 23-record re-run list in emc-hypoxia-therapeutic-status.json's every_registered_EMC_trial.studies (NCT03600649, status UNKNOWN; NCT05836571, status ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING).
p1s.evidence: research/literature/fet-fusion-trial-eligibility-2026-08-07.json, task_1_reverification_of_section_3_3.trials: NCT03600649 has emc_in_listed_conditions:true with 'Extraskeletal Myxoid Chondrosarcoma' verbatim in listed_conditions; NCT05836571 has emc_in_listed_conditions:true with 'Locally Advanced Extraskeletal Myxoid Chondrosarcoma'. research/modalities/emc-hypoxia-therapeutic-status.json, every_registered_EMC_trial (_n_total_reported:23, n=23 studies via query.cond=extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma) lists both NCT03600649 and NCT05836571 alongside NCT06239272. So among the 23, at least 2–3 records (not 1) list the histology; NCT06239272 is unique only among *recruiting* trials — the qualifier §3's table states explicitly (‘One recruiting trial does list the histology’) but §2's earlier-appearing sentence drops.
p1s.fix: In §2, qualify the clause — e.g. ‘NCT06239272, the one *recruiting* record that lists the histology’ — so the phrase matches §3's already-correct qualified claim and cannot be read as a count over the full 23.
